title: Frontend pure functions tested via vitest in same directory
context: Pure functions need fast testing without DOM overhead; component testing needs jsdom but only where necessary.
decision: Pure frontend functions tested via vitest with node environment (default). Per-file `// @vitest-environment jsdom` enables React Testing Library for component tests. jsdom held at v29 via pnpm.overrides for Node 20 compatibility.
consequences: Pure modules pay zero cost for DOM. Component tests only where needed. CI pin (Node 20) drives jsdom version. Tests live beside source in same region (import rules enforced §1.2).
